'use strict';
function typedStrict(value:number){'use strict';return value;}
const optionalStrict=(value?:number)=>{'use strict';return value??2;};
class StrictParameterProperty { constructor(public value:number){'use strict';} }
function typedThisStrict(this:{value:number},other:number){'use strict';return this.value+other;}
function inheritedStrict(value=5){return value;}
console.log(typedStrict(1),optionalStrict(),new StrictParameterProperty(3).value,typedThisStrict.call({value:2},2),inheritedStrict());
